behavior_change: Classify cue, change or turning-point, and surprise roles only when current-source wording explicitly signals them.
Display cue, change or turning-point, surprise, and conflict role counts in the M2 UI.

Prepare an exact-commit W7900 runner, fixed public scenario, failure retention, sanitized environment capture and automatic packet finalizer.
